title: Roja Partners With PSQ Payments to Power Processing on Its Earned Wage Access Platform
summary: White-label earned wage access provider selects PSQ Payments to assist in processing disbursements and repayments for its platform, expanding the Company’s fintech footprint into a new EWA vertical. PSQ Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: PSQH) (the "Company"), a payments infrastructure provider designed to assist businesses underserved by mainstream financial services companies, today announced that Roja, a turnkey, white-label Earned Wage Access (“EWA”) platform, has selected PSQ Payments to power payment processing for its clients' EWA programs. Roja enables partner organizations to launch fully branded, subscription-based EWA experiences, without building their own infrastructure, workflows, or consumer applications. Integrating PSQ Payments allows Roja's clients to move funds to customers ahead of payday and collect repayments reliably, without the processing disruptions that have affected other companies in the earned wage access space.
